newsitem.title: USA: Home State to be delisted from Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Home State to be delisted from Nasdaq.

text.p: Home State Holdings Inc on Friday said it was scheduled to be delisted from the Nasdaq at the opening of business on July 21.
The move is being made because of its failure to meet certain, unspecified listing requirements, it said.
The company also said it had dismissed its independent accountants, Coopers & Lybrand LLP. No reason was given for the dismissal, and company officials were not immediately available for comment.
Last month, Home State, a property and casualty insurance company, said its subsidiaries were ceasing to write new business after discussions with potential investors ended.
At that time, Home State said it was exploring the possible sale of its subsidiaries. The company operates primarily in New Jersey, Pennsylvania and Delaware.
